"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Millions of acres of natural lands have been protected, including Redwood forests, the Florida Everglades, the Grand Canyon, Yellowstone, and Yosemite.",

"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Today's Republicans see national parks as a playground for big businesses to exploit with drilling and mining.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Republicans have tried to sell off national parks, gut air, water, and endangered species protections, let polluters off the hook, and put special interests ahead of the people's interest.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The natural environment is too precious and too important to waste.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
